Spray Dried Beetroot Powder for Color and Flavor in Food Production

Tradenest Naturals supplies spray dried beetroot powder to food and beverage manufacturers that want a natural red-purple color from a vegetable source. Fresh beetroot juice is spray dried into a fine, soluble powder with a deep hue and an earthy, slightly sweet taste. As a spray dried beetroot powder supplier, we supply every batch to a fixed specification. Drying is fast. This helps keep the betalain pigments that give beetroot its familiar deep red shade.

Processing Method

Fresh beetroots are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. They are washed, trimmed and pressed, and the juice is filtered. The juice is then sprayed into a hot air chamber, where it dries into a fine powder in a few seconds. Short contact with heat helps protect color and flavor. The process also gives an even particle size, which matters for industrial mixing and dosing. As a result, our wholesale spray dried beetroot powder blends evenly into both liquid and dry formulations.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Beetroot Powder?

Many buyers are looking for a dependable bulk spray dried beetroot powder supplier India can provide at export scale. We focus on steady quality from lot to lot. The powder is made from beetroot juice, and full composition details, including any drying carrier, are given on the specification sheet. That transparency helps teams working on clean-label products. As a spray dried beetroot powder exporter, we offer export documentation support and sturdy export packing. Color strength matters to our customers, so we keep the powder well sealed to hold its shade in storage.

Technical Specifications and Quality Assurance

Food safety is built into each step. Our facility works to written SOPs that reduce the risk of contamination. Moisture is checked on every batch to keep it below 5%, and mesh is checked against the 80-100 mesh standard. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. The powder is fine enough to dissolve quickly in beverages and disperse evenly in seasoning blends. If you have a particular particle size in mind, please share it with your inquiry.

Common Industrial Applications

The powder is used in many sectors. Beverage makers use it to color juices, smoothies and drink mixes. Bakers add it to breads, cakes and muffins for color. Snack producers use it in seasoning blends and coatings. Because the color is strong, a small dose goes a long way. This can help keep your formulation costs in check.

What certifications and quality standards apply? Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. Each batch carries a lot number for traceability. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options?
